blockDescriptions.block_04: Advanced Prompting — few-shot, chain-of-thought, complex tasks

personalizationRules: Every node MUST include syllabusBlockId set to exactly one block id from the catalog.

Personalization is STRUCTURAL: vary which blocks appear, how many nodes each block gets, difficulty, and order — NOT just rewording titles. A pathway that only rephrases titles while keeping identical block counts is INVALID.
block_05a and block_05b are alternative emphasis tracks. Most pathways should prioritize ONE of them (3+ nodes). Only include both fully for profiles explicitly wanting breadth.
prereq_1 Very uncertain OR bloom_remember shows no prior AI courses: assign 3+ nodes to block_01 at beginner difficulty before block_02.
prereq_1 Very confident OR bloom_remember lists ML/neural networks/gradient descent/PyTorch: assign at most 1 node to block_01, then emphasize block_02 and block_05b.
goals mentioning business, organization, strategy, transformation, workplace: prioritize block_05a (3+ nodes) over block_05b.
goals mentioning research, technical, RAG, fine-tuning, workflows, academic: prioritize block_05b (3+ nodes) over block_05a.
goals mentioning ethics, responsible AI, bias, societal impact, health equity, patient safety: assign 4+ nodes to block_06 (more than a neutral profile would get).
goals mentioning structured prompting, prompt templates, few-shot, chain-of-thought: assign 3+ nodes combined across block_03 and block_04 unless profile also needs heavy block_01.
bloom_remember mentions ChatGPT or daily prompting WITHOUT ML background: still assign 1-2 block_01 nodes for foundations; compress block_03+block_04 only if goals do NOT emphasize prompting mastery.

CRITICAL — learning_1 (learning style) has ZERO effect on structure: it must NOT change syllabusBlockId sequence, block counts, difficulty, or order. Only change description wording (e.g., 'visual diagram' vs 'hands-on exercise'). Two profiles differing ONLY in learning_1 must produce IDENTICAL block sequences.
Total pathway: 10-14 nodes. Include at least one assessment node. block_06 must appear in every pathway (capstone, at least 2 nodes for neutral profiles).

dimensions.description: Pathway depth in block_01 vs block_02 matches prereq_1 and bloom_remember
block_05a vs block_05b emphasis matches stated learning goals
Block coverage and node counts differ meaningfully from a generic path — not title paraphrase only
All syllabusBlockId values valid; content aligns with block catalog; no off-syllabus topics
Dependencies, difficulty progression, and capstone ethics are logical
